messages:
Taylor: Quick heads up  I submitted my resignation today; last day Fri 2026-09-03. I'm on a sponsored visa and use a company laptop plus vendor API keys. Need an offboard plan that covers visa paperwork, vendor creds, and a short knowledge transfer.
Riley: Thanks for the notice. We'll coordinate. HR note: final benefits date will be 2026-09-17 and COBRA notice will go out 2026-09-04. We should schedule an exit interview next week.
IT: Proposed minimal-impact timeline:
- 09:00 final day: set Slack to Away
- 11:30 final day: lock repo write and revoke CI deploy tokens; make repos read-only
- 14:00 final day: rotate vendor API keys and delete personal vault paths
- 15:00 final day: deactivate Okta + VPN
Commands we'll run (audit attached to JIRA):
```
oktactl deactivate-user --user taylor
vault kv delete secret/vendors/partnerX/taylor
aws iam remove-user-from-group --group-name Engineers --user-name taylor
```
Security: Please snapshot active sessions and export 30 days of auth logs before rotations. If Taylor has any service accounts that reference their user, rotate those immediately.
Payroll: Final paycheck and PTO payout will process 2026-09-10. COBRA packet email sent 2026-09-04. We'll send tax paperwork as needed.
offboard-bot: Reminder  please create an OFFBOARD ticket in JIRA and attach the Notion checklist template.
Taylor: Uploaded handoff doc and migration notes to the drive: https://drive.redwood.com/handovers/taylor-handoff.pdf. I can do a 30-min walk-through Thu 16:00. Laptop will be dropped at HQ reception on final day morning.
Riley: Scheduled handoff Thu 16:00 and created JIRA OFFBOARD-4120. IT and Security please post rotation proofs to OFFBOARD-4120 before closing.
IT: We'll run rotations at 14:00 on final day and post logs to the JIRA ticket.
Security: Exported logs and confirmed no lingering entitlements after rotations.
Payroll: COBRA email sent and final pay scheduled.
Riley: Laptop confirmed received by People Ops. OFFBOARD-4120 moved to Done after all artifacts attached. Closing loop  thanks everyone.
